limitations: The committed corpus contains text references, not clinical documents or PHI.
Real OCR runs must provide predictions generated by a named local engine and language configuration.
Arabic OCR character accuracy does not validate Arabic clinical NER or assertion context.
Handwriting, complex tables, stamps, rotation, and degraded scans require broader fixtures.
